title: What the Pangolin guards

is_this_you.pressure: Loud trouble comes and you curl around the soft part. You wait inside until the footsteps lose interest.
is_this_you.love: You plug the burrow from inside at night. Some nights you forget to leave a gap for the one you love.
is_this_you.cost: Your trust is so rare that people speak of it as luck. Some wait years and never get it.

opener.text: Among the Lele of the Kasai, in what is now the DR Congo, the Pangolin cult was the most senior cult in the village [s11]. The anthropologist Mary Douglas read the pangolin there as an odd but lucky animal that crosses the lines between kinds, a go-between [s11] [s12]. People bring you the things that need carrying across.

tabs.label: The armour
tabs.intro: Earth outside. A small fire kept under the scales.

rows.text: Taurus is fixed Earth, ruled by Venus, gentle and patient and hard to move [s1] [s2]. The Snake is yin Fire, intuitive and strategic, a good communicator who says little [s4] [s5]. Your Fire sits inside the Earth like a coal in a banked hearth. People see the calm. Few get close enough to feel the heat.

A pangolin's scales are keratin, the same protein as a fingernail [s6] [s7]. When threatened it rolls into a ball most predators cannot open, though big cats still take some [s7] [s8]. Your calm is built the same way. It holds most days.
Its eyesight is weak, so it finds buried ant and termite nests by smell [s6] [s7]. You find the buried thing in people the same way. You rarely explain how you knew where to dig.

The anthropologist Martin Walsh records that the Sangu of southwest Tanzania believed pangolins fell from the sky, sent by the ancestors [s10]. If one shed tears during the dance held for it, good rains were coming [s10]. You end up carrying word between people who stopped talking.

Pangolins are described as the most trafficked mammals in the world, and all eight species are on CITES Appendix I [s6]. Old Chinese medicine books prescribed the scales, but there is no scientific evidence any of it works, and China dropped pangolin from its 2020 Pharmacopoeia [s6] [s13]. The armour was never medicine. It belongs on the animal.
Archives, audits, conservation and anti-trafficking work all reward a good nose and a closed mouth.

tabs.label: Who you uncurl for
tabs.intro: Three you open for. One who pulls at the scales.
tabs.love_lead: In love you open slowly and stay. Venus rules your sign, so touch and beauty say more to you than speeches [s1]. You need someone who never pulls at the scales and lets you unroll in your own time. The old pairings name three.

easy.why: The Andean Condor (Capricorn, Rooster year) shares your trine of Snake, Ox and Rooster, the Rooster being the Snake's best match, and Capricorn is Earth like you [s3] [s4].
The New Caledonian Crow (Virgo, Monkey year) is your secret friend, since the Monkey is the Snake's six-harmony partner, and Virgo is the third Earth sign [s3] [s1].
The Asian Elephant (Cancer, Ox year) is trine kin through the Ox, with Cancer's Water to soften your Earth [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Deep Sea Anglerfish (Scorpio, Pig year): the Pig clashes with the Snake, and Scorpio sits opposite Taurus [s3] [s1].

story.text: Among the Jindwi of Zimunya communal land in Zimbabwe, whoever found a pangolin carried it to the chief, who let it go into the forest, as Christopher Zimunya told Mongabay [s9]. The steps it took before it vanished were said to count the good years the finder would live [s9].

closing: When you finally uncurl for someone, let them count your steps. Each one is a good year.
